SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   C. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever
